headline: Trump 🍊👑 WALKS OUT 🚶‍♂️💨 NBC Interview After Kristen Clashes 🥊🗳️
text: Trump 🍊👑 STORMS OFF 🚶‍♂️💨 the NBC barn 🐄🌧️ after Kristen Welker 📰💅 kept GRILLING 🥩🔥 him on 'RIGGED' 🗳️🧀 vibes for 2020 and Cali primaries! Rain ☔️💦 kept SLAPPING the metal roof 🏠🥁 while tech gremlins 🧌💻 delayed the sit-down for hours! Trump claimed Cali votes were CHEATED 🍟🗳️ and said 'I just LOOK 👀 and LISTEN 👂' when pressed for proof. Welker clapped back 'That's NOT evidence 📜❌' and Trump snapped 'You're either CROOKED 🦹‍♀️ or STUPID 🧠❄️' before calling it QUITS 🛑🍆! He roasted the 'dishonest press' 📺😈 and stormed out yelling 'Come on let's GO 🏃‍♂️💨' after an hour of wet drama 🌧️🎭. Earlier he flexed about Iran nukes 💣☢️ saying 'threat largely OVER 🏁' in a few months, then dodged questions about the dropped $1.8B anti-weaponization fund 💸🛡️ that Dems and some GOP hated cuz it might pay 1/6 rioters 🏛️🥊. Welker later said they made up 🤝☎️ and Trump agreed to a do-over interview! The whole saga was one big media beef 🍔📺 with Trump calling the press 'crooked' like his fave catchphrase! 😂🗣️
